set -eu
getent group fleet-https >/dev/null 2>&1 || groupadd --system fleet-https
id fleet-https >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd --system --gid fleet-https --home-dir /nonexistent --shell /sbin/nologin fleet-https
install -d -m 755 /usr/local/libexec
cat > /usr/local/libexec/fleet-https-server <<'FLEET_PY_EOF'
#!/usr/bin/python3
import http.server
import ssl

class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        body = b"node2 HTTPS service\n"
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        print("%s - %s" % (self.address_string(), fmt % args), flush=True)

server = http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8443), Handler)
context = ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_SERVER)
context.minimum_version = ssl.TLSVersion.TLSv1_2
context.load_cert_chain(
    certfile="/etc/pki/tls/certs/node2-https.crt",
    keyfile="/etc/pki/tls/private/node2-https.key",
)
server.socket = context.wrap_socket(server.socket, server_side=True)
server.serve_forever()
FLEET_PY_EOF
chmod 755 /usr/local/libexec/fleet-https-server
chown root:fleet-https /etc/pki/tls/private/node2-https.key
chmod 640 /etc/pki/tls/private/node2-https.key
cat > /etc/systemd/system/fleet-https.service <<'FLEET_UNIT_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Fleet node2 HTTPS service
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=fleet-https
Group=fleet-https
ExecStart=/usr/local/libexec/fleet-https-server
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2s
NoNewPrivileges=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
FLEET_UNIT_EOF
chmod 644 /etc/systemd/system/fleet-https.service
restorecon -F /usr/local/libexec/fleet-https-server /etc/systemd/system/fleet-https.service /etc/pki/tls/private/node2-https.key /etc/pki/tls/certs/node2-https.crt /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/fleet-internal-ca.crt 2>/dev/null || true
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now fleet-https.service
systemctl is-enabled fleet-https.service
systemctl is-active fleet-https.service
